specification_sections: GSI elevation datum revision notice effective 2025-07-31
dem.horizontal_contract: GSI states JGD2024 horizontal definitions are unchanged from JGD2011; EPSG:6668 is used with no-ballpark transform from EPSG:4326.
dem.vertical_contract: The verified package was downloaded after the 2025-07-31 GSI provision change; the official update notice binds provided elevation to JGD2024 even where member source-update dates are earlier. Products remain separate.
dem.attribution: 基盤地図情報（国土地理院）を加工して作成
